title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator North Birmingham 3 month temporary contract £28,000 Full Time Immediate Start

Gleeson Recruitment Group are currently supporting a well-established organisation in north Birmingham with the recruitment of an HR Administrator to join their team on an initial 3-month temporary basis. This is a great opportunity for an experienced HR Administrator to join a busy, structured HR function where you will provide hands-on administrative support across the employee lifecycle.

The Role

Working as part of the wider HR team, you will provide accurate and efficient HR administration support, including:
- Preparing and issuing employment contracts and associated documentation
- Supporting the onboarding process for new starters
- Completing and maintaining Right to Work checks
- Updating and maintaining accurate employee records
- Supporting general HR administration across the employee lifecycle
- Responding to employee and manager queries where appropriate
- Ensuring HR processes and documentation are completed accurately and in line with company procedures

About You

We are looking for someone who has solid HR administration experience gained within a large or complex organisation.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience working in an HR Administrator / HR Coordinator position
- Strong understanding of core HR administration processes
- Experience managing contracts, onboarding and Right to Work checks
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Confidence working with HR systems and maintaining accurate employee records
- The ability to work in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
- Experience within a larger organisation, where established HR processes and procedures are in place

To apply for the position, please click on the apply now button and your CV will be sent directly to the responsible recruiter. We will respond to successful applicants within 7 days, however please feel free to get in touch if you would like any further information about your application.

At Gleeson Recruitment Group, we embrace inclusivity and welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We are proud to be a disability confident employer.

By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Gleeson Recruitment Limited. Our Privacy Policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: HR Administrator
description:

Location: Solihull
Hybrid - 3 days in the office
£30,000

The role will include:
- Managing onboarding, contractual changes, promotions, transfers and leavers
- Preparing contracts, offer letters and HR documentation

If you're looking for a broad HR role where you can get involved across several areas of the function, please get in touch.

title: Talent Administrator
description:
Job Advertisement: Talent Acquisition Administrator

Temporary 4-8 week contract

Full time - 9am-5pm

Are you ready to take your career in talent acquisition to the next level? Our client, a prominent organisation in the Consulting and Professional Services sector, is seeking a dedicated and motivated Talent Acquisition Administrator to join their dynamic team in Sutton Coldfield on a temporary basis. This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to an exciting and fast-paced environment where every day brings new challenges and rewards!

About the Role:

As a Talent Acquisition Administrator, you will play a vital role in supporting the recruitment process, ensuring that top talent is identified and engaged effectively. Your organisational skills and attention to detail will be crucial in creating a seamless recruitment experience.

Key Responsibilities:
- Assist in the coordination of recruitment activities from job posting to onboarding.
- Manage candidate databases and maintain accurate records of applications and interviews.
- Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process, providing timely updates.
- Support the Talent Acquisition team with administrative tasks, including scheduling interviews and preparing recruitment materials.
- Ensure a positive candidate experience by addressing inquiries and providing information about the organisation and role.
- Collaborate with hiring managers to understand their recruitment needs and assist in developing job descriptions.

What Our Client Offers:
- A vibrant and supportive work environment that values collaboration and innovation.
- Opportunities for professional growth and development within the organisation.
- A chance to work with a diverse team of passionate professionals dedicated to excellence in consulting and business services.

Our client is looking for individuals who are enthusiastic, proactive, and eager to learn. The ideal candidate will possess:
- Previous experience in an administrative role, preferably within recruitment or HR.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
- Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
- A keen eye for detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) is a plus.

How to Apply:

If you are excited about the opportunity to support talent acquisition efforts in a leading organisation, please submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience.

Take the next step in your career today! Our client is eager to welcome a new Talent Acquisition Administrator who shares their passion for excellence and innovation. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity - apply now!

Adecco acts as an employment agency for permanent recruitment and an employment business for the supply of temporary workers. The Adecco Group UK & Ireland is an Equal Opportunities Employer.

By applying for this role your details will be submitted to Adecco. Our Candidate Privacy Information Statement explaining how we will use your information is available on our website.
